name: Mersey Gateway and Silver Jubilee bridges toll
law: Halton Borough Council's Road User Charging Scheme Order, toll charges from 1 April 2025 (merseyflow's summary; a table published as an image, transcribed in tools/tables/transcribed/gb-merseyflow-2025.json): per crossing of either bridge, either way, class 3 (3.5-12 t) GBP 7.20, class 4 (over 12 t) GBP 9.60 unregistered; with `etc` the sticker-registered price (6.50, 8.65).

sources.title: merseyflow: Toll charge and scheme detail changed on 1 April 2025

tolled_roads: The Mersey Gateway Bridge (A533) and the Silver Jubilee Bridge, Runcorn–Widnes, either way.
